workouts.name: BARBELL BENCH PRESS
workouts.description: A compound press that builds chest thickness, triceps, and pressing power from a stable bench.
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with your eyes directly under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar slowly toward your mid chest.
Press the bar back up while keeping your feet firmly planted.

workouts.name: BACK SQUAT
workouts.description: A fundamental lower-body movement targeting the quads, glutes, and hamstrings.
instructions: Place the bar comfortably across your upper back.
Brace your core and keep your chest lifted.
Descend by bending your knees and hips.
Drive through your feet to return to standing.

workouts.name: DEADLIFT
workouts.description: A powerful compound lift that develops the posterior chain and overall strength.
instructions: Stand with your feet under the bar.
Grip the bar and keep your back neutral.
Push through the floor while extending your hips.
Lower the bar under control.

workouts.name: PULL UPS
workouts.description: A bodyweight pulling exercise that builds back width and upper-body strength.
instructions: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to the starting position.

workouts.name: OVERHEAD PRESS
workouts.description: A standing press that develops shoulder strength and upper-body stability.
instructions: Hold the bar at shoulder height.
Brace your core before pressing.
Press the bar overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulders.

workouts.name: BARBELL ROW
workouts.description: A horizontal pulling movement designed to build a thick and powerful back.
instructions: Hinge forward while keeping your back flat.
Hold the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Lower the bar under control.

workouts.name: DUMBBELL CURL
workouts.description: A simple isolation exercise focused on building the biceps.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly.

workouts.name: TRICEP PUSHDOWN
workouts.description: A focused triceps movement using a cable machine.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Push the handle downward.
Return slowly to the starting position.

workouts.name: LEG PRESS
workouts.description: A machine-based lower-body exercise for developing strong legs.
instructions: Place your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower the platform with control.
Keep your knees aligned with your toes.
Push the platform away without locking your knees.

workouts.name: DUMBBELL LATERAL RAISE
workouts.description: An isolation movement targeting the side deltoids.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly.

workouts.name: ROMANIAN DEADLIFT
workouts.description: A hip-hinge exercise that strongly targets the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold the bar close to your thighs.
Push your hips backward while keeping your back neutral.
Lower the bar until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

workouts.name: RUSSIAN TWIST
workouts.description: A rotational core exercise that challenges the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and feet slightly raised.
Hold the medicine ball in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso from side to side.
Keep your core tight throughout the movement.
